definitions.explanation: The direction or side opposite to right.

examples.japanese: {左|ひだり}に{曲|ま}がってください。
{左|ひだり}に{郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}が{見|み}えます。
examples.english: You can see the post office on the left.

examples.japanese: {左手|ひだりて}で{書|か}きます。
examples.english: I write with my left hand.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}の{左|ひだり}に{大|おお}きな{木|き}があります。
examples.english: There is a big tree on the left side of the road.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}を{出|で}たら{左|ひだり}に{歩|ある}いてください。{三分|さんぷん}ぐらいで{着|つ}きます。
examples.english: When you leave the station, walk to the left. You'll arrive in about three minutes.

notes:
{左|ひだり} indicates the left direction, opposite of {右|みぎ}.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {左|ひだり}に{曲|ま}がる: to turn left
- {左|ひだり}を{見|み}る: to look left
- {左|ひだり}から{右|みぎ}へ: from left to right

COMPOUNDS:
- {左手|ひだりて}: left hand
- {左足|ひだりあし}: left foot/leg
- {左側|ひだりがわ}: left side
- {左折|させつ}: left turn (traffic term)
- {左利|ひだりき}き: left-handed

TRAFFIC NOTE:
In Japan, traffic drives on the left side of the road.

POLITICAL USAGE:
{左|ひだり}/{左翼|さよく} can mean "left-wing" in political contexts.
